workflow_runs.display_title: [codex] reuse shared state DB across cold lookup paths

head_commit.message:
Cache state DB runtime for repeated lookups

Reuse a cached StateRuntime for ad hoc core state DB lookups, but keep state_db::init() on its own runtime so session-owned work does not share a single SQLite pool. Also make open_if_present() reuse-only when no default provider is available to avoid cold lookups reinitializing the logs DB.

Co-authored-by: Codex <noreply@openai.com>
